def transform(grid):
    # Fill the triangular wedge bounded by the first and last marker diagonals.
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        marks=[c for c,v in enumerate(row) if v]
        if len(marks)>=2:
            for c in range(min(marks)+1,max(marks)):
                if row[c]==0: out[r][c]=2
    return out
PY
